name: receipts
description: Proof-of-work for Claude Code. Gets Claude to run your whole test suite after its last change, names what an edit can break (JS/TS, Python, .NET), and checks every "tests pass / build is clean / it works" against what actually ran: stale, failed, filtered or miscounted runs and weakened tests. Warns by default; "mode": "block" sends Claude back. Also audits subagents, breaks retry loops, scans your history, and adds a status line and PR verification receipts.
